_comment_lan_url: On fleet_subnet, viewer fetches fleet from this LAN base first (e.g. http://192.168.x.x:PORT). Falls back to url (halus) on failure or when off-subnet. Real host only in gitignored edge.json.
_comment_fleet_subnet: When this Mac has an IPv4 in fleet_subnet, viewer prefers lan_url; otherwise uses halus (url). Real subnet only in gitignored edge.json.
